quests.instruction: A dinner has grilled fish, brown rice and orange slices. Which food would add the missing vegetable group?
quests.hint: Sort each food on the plate into its group first.
quests.explanation: Fish is a protein food, rice is a grain and oranges are fruit, so broccoli brings in the vegetable group.
quests.funFact: Steaming vegetables helps them keep their bright color.

quests.instruction: Compare a banana and a raisin. Which statement is true?
quests.correctAnswer: Raisins last longer because they are dried 🍇
options: Raisins last longer because they are dried 🍇
Both last exactly the same time ⚖️
Bananas last longer because they are fresh 🍌
quests.hint: Ask yourself what has been removed from one of them.
quests.explanation: Raisins have lost most of their water, and germs need water to grow, so raisins keep for a long time. Fresh bananas spoil much sooner.
quests.funFact: Raisins are grapes that have had most of their water taken out.

quests.instruction: Which list shows how to make vegetable soup safely, in the right order?
quests.correctAnswer: Wash hands, rinse vegetables, simmer, serve 🍲
options: Simmer, wash hands, serve, rinse vegetables 🍲
Wash hands, rinse vegetables, simmer, serve 🍲
Serve, simmer, rinse vegetables, wash hands 🍲
quests.hint: Clean hands and clean vegetables come first.
quests.explanation: Hands are washed first, then the vegetables are rinsed, the soup simmers and finally it is served.
quests.funFact: Soups are often simmered gently so the flavors have time to blend.

quests.instruction: Which list contains a root, a leaf and a seed from plants?
quests.hint: Think about different parts of a plant.
quests.explanation: A carrot is a root, lettuce is a leaf and peas are seeds. The other lists hold fruits or dairy foods.
quests.funFact: We eat many different plant parts: roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruits and seeds.

quests.instruction: Which of these does not come from a plant or an animal at all?
quests.hint: It is a mineral.
quests.explanation: Salt is a mineral. Honey comes from bees and rice comes from a plant.
quests.funFact: Salt is one of the few foods we eat that is a rock-like mineral.

quests.instruction: A baker has no eggs for cookie dough. Which ingredient can sometimes help hold the dough together?
quests.hint: It is soft and sticky.
quests.explanation: Mashed banana is sticky, so it can act like glue in some recipes. Juice and water are too runny.
quests.funFact: Applesauce and mashed banana are popular egg swaps in some recipes.

quests.instruction: A cook has just handled raw chicken. What should happen before touching fresh salad vegetables?
quests.correctAnswer: Wash hands, scrub the board with soap 🧼
options: Wipe hands quickly on the kitchen apron 👕
Rinse the raw chicken in the kitchen sink 🚰
Wash hands, scrub the board with soap 🧼
quests.hint: Germs from raw meat must not reach foods eaten raw.
quests.explanation: Washing hands and scrubbing the board with soap removes germs from the raw chicken before the salad is prepared.
quests.funFact: Raw chicken juices can splash, so cooks avoid rinsing raw meat in the sink.

quests.instruction: A bowl of snacks has sat out at a party all afternoon. Which one is safest to eat?
quests.hint: Ask yourself which foods spoil quickly.
quests.explanation: Dry crackers keep well at room temperature. Cut melon and cooked rice with chicken can grow germs if they sit out.
quests.funFact: Dry foods keep much better than moist, cut or cooked foods when left out.

quests.instruction: A soup is too thin. Which natural addition could thicken it?
quests.hint: Starch makes liquids thicker.
quests.explanation: Mashed potato adds starch and makes soup thicker. Water and ice make it thinner.
quests.funFact: Many cooks thicken soups by blending some of the vegetables.

quests.instruction: Which list shows how corn becomes a tortilla, in the right order?
quests.correctAnswer: Corn is dried and ground, dough is mixed, tortilla is cooked 🌽
options: Tortilla is cooked, corn is dried and ground, dough is mixed 🌽
Corn is dried and ground, dough is mixed, tortilla is cooked 🌽
Dough is mixed, tortilla is cooked, corn is dried and ground 🌽
quests.hint: The corn must be ground before it can be mixed.
quests.explanation: Corn is dried and ground into flour, then mixed into dough and cooked into a tortilla.
quests.funFact: In Mexico, corn is often soaked in lime water, which makes the dough easier to shape.

quests.instruction: Which statement is true for both an apple and a carrot?
options: Foods with no water in them 💧
quests.hint: Ask yourself where fiber comes from.
quests.explanation: Apples and carrots both grow on plants and contain fiber. Neither comes from an animal and both hold plenty of water.
quests.funFact: Apples and carrots are crunchy because their cells are full of water.

quests.instruction: What do bread dough, yogurt and kimchi have in common?
quests.correctAnswer: Tiny living things help make them 🦠
options: They are all frozen when they are made 🧊
Tiny living things help make them 🦠
quests.hint: Think about yeast and bacteria.
quests.explanation: Yeast helps bread rise and bacteria help turn milk into yogurt and cabbage into kimchi.
quests.funFact: Foods made with the help of tiny living things are called fermented foods.

quests.instruction: What food is crunchy, salty and made from corn?
quests.hint: Check all three clues.
quests.explanation: Tortilla chips match all three clues. Pretzels are made from wheat and cookies are sweet.
quests.funFact: Tortilla chips started as a way to use up leftover tortillas.

quests.instruction: Which ingredient makes tiny bubbles that help cakes and pancakes puff up?
quests.hint: It reacts when it gets wet and warm.
quests.explanation: Baking powder makes gas bubbles in batter, which makes it rise. Oil and plain flour do not do that.
quests.funFact: Baking powder is a mix of baking soda and a dry acid.

quests.instruction: A recipe serves four people, but eight are coming. What should the cook do with the ingredients?
quests.hint: You need twice as many servings.
quests.explanation: Eight is twice four, so the amounts should be doubled.
quests.funFact: Cooks also check that the pot or pan is big enough when they make more.

quests.instruction: A label lists: oats, raisins, honey, salt. Which ingredient is there the most of?
quests.hint: Consider the order of an ingredients list.
quests.explanation: The first ingredient is the one there is most of, so oats come first.
quests.funFact: Reading the order of ingredients can help you compare two similar snacks.

quests.instruction: Which child should not eat a snack labeled 'Contains: milk and wheat'?
options: A child allergic to bee stings 🐝
quests.hint: The label names foods that can cause reactions.
quests.explanation: The label says the snack contains wheat, so a child who is allergic to wheat must avoid it. Bee stings and dust are not foods.
quests.funFact: Food allergies are different from allergies to things like dust or pollen.

quests.instruction: A shopper has $10. Apples cost $3, bread $2, milk $4 and eggs $5. Which group of items can the shopper buy?
quests.hint: Add up each group of prices.
quests.explanation: Apples, bread and milk cost $9. The other groups cost $11 and $12, which is too much.
quests.funFact: Adding up prices as you shop helps you stay within a budget.

quests.instruction: A soup tastes far too salty. What could help?
quests.correctAnswer: Add more water or unsalted vegetables 🍲
options: Boil it hard until it is almost dry 🔥
Add another big spoonful of salt 🧂
Add more water or unsalted vegetables 🍲
quests.hint: Think about spreading the saltiness out.
quests.explanation: More water or plain vegetables spread the salt out so it tastes less strong. Adding salt or boiling away the water makes it worse.
quests.funFact: A little lemon juice can also make a salty dish taste more balanced.

quests.instruction: What snack gives both fiber and protein?
options: A tall cold glass of apple juice 🧃
Plain crackers eaten all by themselves 🍘
quests.hint: Look for a fruit paired with a protein food.
quests.explanation: Apple slices bring fiber and peanut butter brings protein. Crackers alone and juice have little of both.
quests.funFact: Pairing a fruit with a protein food makes a snack that keeps you going longer.

quests.instruction: A bento box holds rice, grilled fish, pickled cucumber and orange slices. Which food group is missing?
quests.hint: Sort each food in the box into its group first.
quests.explanation: Rice is a grain, fish is protein, cucumber is a vegetable and oranges are fruit, so no dairy food is in the box.
quests.funFact: Bento boxes are Japanese packed lunches that put small portions of many foods in compartments.

quests.instruction: Which list shows how yogurt is made, in the right order?
quests.correctAnswer: Warm the milk, add live bacteria, keep it warm, chill it 🥣
options: Warm the milk, add live bacteria, keep it warm, chill it 🥣
Keep it warm, chill it, warm the milk, add live bacteria 🥣
Add live bacteria, chill it, warm the milk, keep it warm 🥣
quests.hint: The bacteria need warm milk to do their work.
quests.explanation: Milk is warmed first, live bacteria are added, the mixture stays warm while it thickens and then it is chilled.
quests.funFact: Yogurt stays warm for several hours so that the bacteria can thicken the milk.

quests.instruction: Put these packed-lunch steps in order. Which list is right?
quests.correctAnswer: Wash hands, pack the food, add an ice pack, close the box 🍱
options: Pack the food, close the box, wash hands, add an ice pack 🍱
Close the box, add an ice pack, pack the food, wash hands 🍱
Wash hands, pack the food, add an ice pack, close the box 🍱
quests.hint: Clean hands touch the food first.
quests.explanation: Hands are washed before food is packed, and the ice pack goes in before the lid closes.
quests.funFact: An ice pack works best when it sits right next to the foods that need to stay cold.

quests.instruction: Which list shows how grass can end up as cheese?
quests.hint: Follow the food from the field to the table.
quests.explanation: A cow eats grass, makes milk, and cheesemakers turn the milk into cheese.
quests.funFact: Every food chain starts with plants that turn sunlight into food.

quests.instruction: I am a yellow dairy food, firm enough to slice, with holes inside, and I am famous in Switzerland. What am I?
quests.hint: Check each clue one at a time.
quests.explanation: Swiss cheese is a firm dairy food with holes. Butter is soft and yogurt is creamy.
quests.funFact: The holes form from gas made by bacteria while the cheese ripens.

quests.instruction: Which food is the fruit of its plant to a scientist, yet is cooked and eaten like a vegetable?
quests.hint: It grows from a flower and holds seeds.
quests.explanation: A tomato grows from a flower and holds seeds, so it is a fruit, but cooks use it like a vegetable. Carrots and onions are a root and a bulb.
quests.funFact: Food guides usually count tomatoes with the vegetables because of how we use them.

quests.instruction: A recipe asks for 'a pinch' of salt. How much is that?
quests.correctAnswer: A tiny amount held between two fingers 🧂
options: A tiny amount held between two fingers 🧂
About as much as fills a whole cup 🥛
A big handful from the bag 🤲
quests.hint: It is the smallest measure in the kitchen.
quests.explanation: A pinch is the little amount you can hold between two fingers.
quests.funFact: Other cooking words for small amounts include dash and sprinkle.

quests.instruction: A child is vegetarian, allergic to peanuts and wants a lunch with protein. Which lunch fits?
quests.correctAnswer: Bean and cheese quesadilla with fruit 🌯
options: A big chicken salad with dressing 🍗
Bean and cheese quesadilla with fruit 🌯
A peanut butter and jelly sandwich 🥜
quests.hint: Rule out anything with meat or peanuts.
quests.explanation: Beans and cheese give protein without meat or peanuts. The sandwich has peanuts and the salad has chicken.
quests.funFact: Beans and cheese together give a lunch plenty of protein without meat.

quests.instruction: A cook has flour, eggs, milk and a pan. Which food can they make?
quests.hint: Think of a batter.
quests.explanation: Flour, eggs and milk make pancake batter, which cooks in a pan. Ice cream and pickles need other ingredients.
quests.funFact: A basic pancake batter needs only a few pantry ingredients.

quests.instruction: Which food's journey includes a farmer, a mill and a baker?
quests.hint: Think of wheat in a field.
quests.explanation: Wheat is grown by a farmer, ground at a mill and baked by a baker into bread. Honey and fish take different journeys.
quests.funFact: Bread links fields, mills and bakeries, which makes it a good example of how food travels from farm to table.
